plan.title: Service PR to split award and PO

steps.note: Give the created event a title so it can be identified later.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule; the catalog has no separate evaluation-duration argument.
Invite exactly two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Submit the first vendor's portal quote at 100.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was submitted.
Submit the second vendor's portal quote at 90.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was submitted.
Wait for bidding to end before reading rankings or awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids are available.
Assert that the lower 90 quote ranks ahead of the 100 quote.
Enter the manual awarding flow needed for a split award.

Complete PO creation from the approved split award.
Confirm the resulting purchase orders contain the two awarded activity lines.
